purpose: Curated source base for V10 / ECGP exploration, combining local anchors and web-discovered datasets.

direct_local_sources.title: Normalized HF transport dataset for Cu, Al, Ag, and Fe
direct_local_sources.why: Provides the material/frequency side of the V10 schema with explicit provenance and normalized real tables.
notes: This is the current in-repo transport anchor for V10-style normalization.
The manifest already references Cu, Al, Ag, and Fe series.

direct_local_sources.title: ECGP demo control trials
direct_local_sources.why: Useful as a structural validator for the bench, but not as evidence for V10 because it is a synthetic control set.
notes: The latest bench run on this file was rejected, which is expected for a flat demo control.
Keep this file as a regression control, not as a discovery dataset.

direct_local_sources.title: ListeDesObservationInexpliquer workbook
direct_local_sources.why: Contains a curated list of unexplained observational points that can seed discriminant tests, but it is not in the ECGP trial schema.
notes: Best used as a hypothesis and test-planning layer above the bench data.
Not directly ingestible by ecgp_bench without a mapping step.

external_sources.title: Telecom Quantum Photonic Interface for a 40Ca+ Single-Ion Quantum Memory
external_sources.why: Contains high-fidelity entanglement under controlled conversion and fiber-loss conditions, with downloadable CSV and measurement files.
notes: Reported entanglement fidelity remains above 95% (98% with background correction).
This is strong for loss/correction studies but does not expose a material symbol in the same sense as HF transport.

external_sources.title: A photonic entanglement filter with Rydberg atoms
external_sources.why: Provides figure data in Excel form and directly targets entanglement filtering with near-unity fidelity.
notes: The platform is Rydberg-atom photonics, which is useful as a control-rich entanglement source.
Raw Excel files were downloaded and locally indexed.
Best used if V10 is extended to photonic/atomic transfer rather than metal-wire transport alone.

external_sources.title: Data underpinning Engineering unsteerable quantum states with active feedback
external_sources.why: Large parameterized simulation dataset with target fidelity and repeated runs; useful for testing robustness of fidelity summaries and control logic.
notes: The preview exposes structured folders by entangled state, N, and target fidelity.
This is a strong robustness source, but it is simulation-heavy rather than a direct transport experiment.
The archive is large enough that this pass records metadata only; the remote archive pointer is preserved in the local index.

external_sources.title: Data from Photonic hybrid state entanglement swapping using cat state superpositions
external_sources.why: Models entanglement fidelity under unequal photonic losses and homodyne imperfections, which is directly relevant to V10 loss-correction logic.
notes: The dataset is code-driven rather than a simple CSV table.
Useful if a Mathematica or exported numeric pipeline is added later.
The notebook has been downloaded locally and indexed as metadata only.

normalization_rules: Keep raw provenance alongside every normalized row.
Separate direct experimental values from control or fitted values.
Use material as the primary platform descriptor only when the source explicitly provides a material or substrate; otherwise store the platform in provenance and keep material null.
Do not promote simulation-only data to direct experimental status.
When a source lacks a V10 field, keep it as an adjacent source and map it later.
